test_atomic_replace_preserves_symlink: test that atomic_replace preserves symlinks by replacing the real target file instead of the symlink
test_atomic_replace_regular_file: test that atomic_replace works correctly on regular non-symlink files
test_atomic_json_write_preserves_symlink: test that atomic_json_write preserves symlinks when writing JSON data to a symlinked file
test_atomic_yaml_write_preserves_symlink: test that atomic_yaml_write preserves symlinks when writing YAML data to a symlinked file
test_atomic_replace_broken_symlink_creat: test that atomic_replace creates the real target file when the symlink points to a missing file
